graph.hint: Scroll to zoom · click a folder to open it · double click opens a note · Ctrl K searches

note.lockedTitle: {{name}} is editing this note right now
note.lockedBanner: {{name}} is editing this note right now. You can read it; editing works once they are done.
note.draftBanner: Created through the MCP access “{{access}}”, {{when}}. It stays marked as a draft until you accept it.

files.title: Files
files.intro: Everything attached to notes. The files sit in the note's folder, next to the .md file.
files.drop: Drop files here, then nexlore asks which note they belong to.

settings.title: Settings
settings.sketch: Sketch in the mockup: nothing here is saved yet.

language.title: Language
language.text: English and German come with nexlore. The operator can add more as JSON files in data/locales; whatever a file leaves out appears in English.
language.templateHint: The English texts as a file to translate. Save it as data/locales/<code>.json, for example es.json or pt-BR.json.

signin.title: Sign-in
signin.text: Accounts with a password, plus an OIDC provider. Whoever signs in through OIDC for the first time gets an account.

spaces.title: Spaces and rights
spaces.text: A space is a folder on disk. Whoever may not see it sees nothing of it in the graph, the search or the backlinks either, not even the title.

mcp.title: AI access (MCP)
mcp.text: Lets AI assistants search, read and write notes. Every key belongs to an account and sees only what that account may see.
mcp.allowHint: Off by default. The operator turns it on for everybody.

mode.draftsText: New notes and changes are marked as AI drafts until you accept them.
mode.writeText: Like a person with the right to write. Every change is in the history.

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.text: Plugins run locked away in the browser and see only what they ask for when installed. They may not go online.

right.writeOpen: reads and writes the open note

calendar.name: Calendar
calendar.text: Daily notes as a month view.

mermaid.name: Mermaid diagrams
mermaid.text: Draws ```mermaid blocks in the reading view.

kanban.name: Kanban board
kanban.text: A note with headings as columns.

templates.name: Templates
templates.text: A new note from a template, with date and placeholders.

readingTime.name: Reading time
readingTime.text: Shows under the title how long reading takes.
